§6Reactor Grade Plutonium§f

§aTwo-thirds Pu-239, one-third Pu-240. Good for fuel, not for bombs.§f

Reactor Grade Plutonium (RGPu) is a mixture of §e66.6%§f Pu-239 (§e6§f nuggets) and §e33.3%§f Pu-240 (§e3§f nuggets). It's a natural product of raw plutonium enrichment.

Properties: §e6.25§f RAD/s, fuel mixture category.

Production: Plutonium Hexafluoride enrichment in a Gas Centrifuge, byproduct of uranium fuel recycling, breeding U-238 in a Chicago Pile, recycling plutonium and MOX fuel, or crafting (6 Pu-239 nuggets + 3 Pu-240 nuggets, shapeless).

Uses: standard plutonium fuel, MOX fuel production, and SILEX separation to refine into pure Pu-239 and Pu-240.

§ePS:§f RGPu is fine for fuel but not for weapons due to Pu-240 content. Use the SILEX to separate it for weapons-grade Pu-239.
